item.title: Doomsday study calculated humanity's end on Friday 13 November 2026
item.description: According to a study, the end of the world was supposed to come on 13 November. It sounds dramatic and would be quite urgent – if the study were not already "outdated". Still, it is fascinating. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: 'Peruvian pope' makes jubilant return to his second 'homeland'
item.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived in his "beloved" Peru on Wednesday, a nostalgic return to the nation where he spent two decades as a missionary before being tapped to lead the world's 1.4 billion Catholics. The 71-year-old pontiff landed in Lima on the last leg of an arduous three-nation Latin American tour, just weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Retired Chinese woman cares for cancer-stricken ex-colleague for a decade, defying gossip
item.description: A retired woman in eastern China has spent 14 years caring for a former colleague with cancer, brushing off gossip to stand by him. According to Jinan Daily, the story began in 2012, when Zhang Ji, now 76, reconnected with her former supervisor, Zhang Hongquan, after years without contact. Widowed, estranged from his adult children and battling rectal cancer, the 82-year-old was living in squalid conditions in a flat in Jinan, Shandong province. The illness had left his left leg blackened and... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Zoey Zhang

item.title: Meet 'Popeye': Pablo Escobar's hitman who claimed involvement in 3,000 killings before becoming a YouTuber
item.description: Jhon Jairo Velásquez, infamously known as 'Popeye', served as a notorious hitman under drug lord Pablo Escobar, reportedly carrying out over 250 murders, including numerous high-profile hits. After 23 years of incarceration, he turned to social media fame with his YouTube channel 'Repentant Popeye,' where he ruminated on his violent past and critiqued governmental actions. Sadly, he succumbed to oesophageal cancer in 2020 following a short imprisonment. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What Southeast Asian newsrooms struggling to attract Gen Z can learn from creators
item.description: For Malaysian content creator Iqbal Fatkhi, making news content credible to younger audiences sometimes means making it less like traditional journalism. Instead of polished broadcasts using formal language, the 33-year-old editor-in-chief of news portal CiliSos Media prefers conversational videos that speak to audiences on their own terms. “It’s ironic in a way that, to gain credibility, you have to look not credible in that sense,” he said. His approach reflects a broader shift in news... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Jeremy Renner’s former Hollywood Hills land becomes $99M mansion
item.description: A luxury mansion in Los Angeles has been relisted for $99 million after a significant price reduction. Previously priced at $125 million, the property has undergone a substantial adjustment to attract buyers. The mansion features seven bedrooms, 12 bathrooms, and spans 22,000 square feet on over an acre of land. It also includes amenities like private access to Runyon Canyon and a 100-foot infinity pool. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Scientists find deadly virus DNA hidden in 1,000-year-old manuscripts
item.description: Ancient manuscripts, including the 1,000-year-old York Gospels, have revealed traces of a deadly sheep virus whose history stretches back more than 3,700 years. Scientists discovered that the virus has remained remarkably unchanged for millennia, turning historic parchment into an unexpected record of ancient disease outbreaks. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Next-gen ultrasound cancer treatment advances: does the evidence match commercial hype?
item.description: Hong Kong is expanding clinical trials of histotripsy, a non-invasive treatment that uses focused ultrasound to destroy tumours, as the city seeks to establish a role in developing the technology for kidney cancer. The CUHK Medical Centre, Gleneagles Hospital Hong Kong and Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital would begin trials involving 30 patients targeting kidney cancer, the Li Ka Shing Foundation said on Wednesday. The trials mark the latest development in Hong Kong business tycoon Li Ka-shing’s... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: Cholera has killed more than 3,000 people worldwide since the start of the year, the World Health Organization said on Tuesday, insisting its goal of cutting global cases by 90 percent by 2030 remained in reach. item.title: Hong Kong customs targets use of astronaut Yang Liwei’s name to sell ‘space oil’
item.description: Hong Kong customs has requested the removal of e-commerce and social media listings by drug dealers who used the name of Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei as a code name to push “space oil”, also known as etomidate. Yang’s name was just one example of the subtle linguistic workarounds used by illicit vendors to evade platform filters. Customs had made about 64 requests to remove illicit items from platforms including Taobao, JD.com and Pinduoduo since signing agreements with them over the past year,... item.description: La nueva generación de fármacos contra la obesidad está a la vuelta de la esquina con menos efectos secundarios y resultados más sorprendentes. Uno de los que está dando mejores sensaciones es la retatrutida, que es un compuesto experimental desarrollado por Eli Lilly y que actúa como un triple agonista hormonal. Pero la buena noticia es que sus efectos pueden ir más allá de la simple pérdida de peso. Bajo estudio.
